# Cash Roundings

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List cash roundings

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings`

Retrieve a paginated list of cash roundings with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: profitAccount, lossAccount, creator | `profitAccount` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by cash rounding name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[strategy]` | string | No | Filter by rounding strategy |  |
| `filter[rounding_method]` | string | No | Filter by rounding method |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings?include=profitAccount&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings?include=profitAccount&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings?include=profitAccount&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create cash rounding

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings`

Create a new cash rounding

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Cash rounding name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `strategy` | string | Yes | Rounding strategy. |
| `rounding_method` | string | Yes | Rounding method. |
| `rounding` | number | Yes | Rounding precision. Must be at least 0. |
| `profit_account_id` | integer | No | Profit account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `loss_account_id` | integer | No | Loss account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "0.05 Rounding",
  "strategy": "biggest_tax",
  "rounding_method": "UP",
  "rounding": 0.05,
  "profit_account_id": 1,
  "loss_account_id": 2
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "0.05 Rounding",
  "strategy": "biggest_tax",
  "rounding_method": "UP",
  "rounding": 0.05,
  "profit_account_id": 1,
  "loss_account_id": 2
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/cash-roundings', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => '0.05 Rounding',
    'strategy' => 'biggest_tax',
    'rounding_method' => 'UP',
    'rounding' => 0.05,
    'profit_account_id' => 1,
    'loss_account_id' => 2,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

